bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
f=/tmp/gace-link62-build-log
test -f "$f" || exit 71
if grep -Eiq 'failed to resolve source metadata|pull access denied|not found: manifest|not found locally' "$f"; then exit 72; fi
if grep -Eiq 'lookup |network is unreachable|i/o timeout|connection refused|connect: network|TLS handshake timeout|failed to fetch' "$f"; then exit 73; fi
if grep -Eiq 'corepack|pnpm.*(error|ERR)|ERR_PNPM|lockfile|npm (ERR|error)' "$f"; then exit 74; fi
if grep -Eiq 'error TS[0-9]+|TypeError|SyntaxError|ERR_MODULE|BUILD FAILED|Cannot find module' "$f"; then exit 75; fi
if grep -Eiq 'no space left|out of memory|Killed|disk quota' "$f"; then exit 76; fi
if grep -Eiq 'failed to solve|failed to compute cache key|COPY failed|lstat.*no such file' "$f"; then exit 77; fi
if grep -Eiq 'permission denied|authorization failed|unauthorized|denied' "$f"; then exit 78; fi
exit 79
